description: Self-contained Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Dataverse) Web API workhorse. Azure AD OAuth 2.0 client_credentials auth (requires a matching Dataverse Application User + security role), retry on 401 (token refresh) / 429 / 5xx. .get()/.post()/.patch() HTTP methods plus upsert_by_key() wrapping Dataverse's native alternate-key upsert (PATCH with Prefer: return=representation to disambiguate created vs updated and recover the row's GUID).

outputs.description: DynamicsCrmResource with get/post/patch HTTP methods plus upsert_by_key(). Consumed by dynamics_crm_record_upsert (sink) and by custom Dagster asset code that needs Dataverse Web API reads/writes.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Resource key. Other components reference it via this name.

client_id_env_var.label: Client Id Env Var
client_id_env_var.description: Env var holding the Azure AD app registration's client ID.

client_secret_env_var.label: Client Secret Env Var
client_secret_env_var.description: Env var holding the Azure AD app registration's client secret.

max_retries.label: Max Retries
max_retries.description: Retry attempts on 429 / 5xx + one on 401 (token refresh).

name: Dynamics CRM Resource
